WANDIMOD-VENGEANCE_POWER.title: Vengeance
WANDIMOD-VENGEANCE_POWER.description:
Whenever Wandi loses HP, he gains 1 Vengeance.
Each stack of Vengeance increases his attack damage by 2%.
Whenever 7 stacks accumulate: consume up to 4 stacks (leave at least 1), then add a Conquer all lands! to his hand.
WANDIMOD-VENGEANCE_POWER.smartDescriptio:
Whenever you lose HP, gain 1 Vengeance. Each stack increases your attack damage by 2%.
Whenever 7 stacks accumulate: consume up to 4 stacks (leave at least 1) and add a [gold]Conquer all lands![/gold] to your hand.
WANDIMOD-CONQUER_PROGRESS_POWER.title: Conquer Progress
WANDIMOD-CONQUER_PROGRESS_POWER.descript: Progress toward Conquer all lands!. The corner number is current progress. At {Threshold}, consume Vengeance (up to 4, leave at least 1) and add one to your hand.
WANDIMOD-CONQUER_PROGRESS_POWER.smartDes: Progress toward [gold]Conquer all lands![/gold] ({Progress}/{Threshold}). At {Threshold}, consume Vengeance and generate the card.
WANDIMOD-STRIFE_POWER.title: Strife
WANDIMOD-STRIFE_POWER.description:
Wandi's temporary Max HP. Each stack of Strife grants 1 Max HP.
When combat ends, all Strife is lost and Max HP returns to normal.
WANDIMOD-STRIFE_POWER.smartDescription:
Temporary Max HP. Each stack grants 1 Max HP.
All Strife is lost when combat ends.

WANDIMOD-BLOODTHIRST_FORM_POWER.descript: While Wandi's HP is at or below 50%, his attacks grant 1 Vengeance when they deal damage (limited times per turn).
